summary: All recorded screens match, but the cursed destroy-armor scroll has one missing C RNG call: do_wear.c:maybe_destroy_armor invokes zap.c:obj_resists on the selected cloak at step 36. js/read.js only ports the ordinary uncursed fallback and refuses this cursed branch. Port the whole read.c destroy-armor effect and its return-valued disintegration helpers, preserving the resistance draw even when the final screen happens to match.

source.branch: read.c:seffect_destroy_armor (1324-1396) selects armor before branching. Confused reads change erosion-proofing. Cursed reads either weaken cursed armor and stun or call do_wear.c:disintegrate_arm. Blessed reads can choose armor and invoke disintegrate_cursed_armor; ordinary reads fall back to destroy_arm. read.c:disintegrate_cursed_armor (1294-1322) selects a cursed worn item and consumes disintegrate_arm result. do_wear.c:disintegrate_arm consumes maybe_destroy_armor, which calls zap.c:obj_resists(armor,0,90) before any visible destruction.
callers: read.c:seffects SCR_DESTROY_ARMOR dispatches seffect_destroy_armor; js/read.js currently admits only an ordinary uncursed fallback.
read.c:doread reaches the dispatch; black dragon breath can also call do_wear.c:disintegrate_arm through its own source path.
dependencies: do_wear.c:disintegrate_arm and maybe_destroy_armor are return-valued callees not yet ported; port them in the same task, including all armor slots and resistance outcomes.
zap.c:obj_resists is already ported in js/bury.js and must receive the source random owner; a zero visible difference does not excuse its rn2(100) call.
Preserve existing ordinary fallback behavior and all matching screens while adding the missing cursed, blessed, and confused branches.

evidence: Saved challenges/evaluations/20260927191056-v8.json at 5b4486322ffa5eeb91cc37d01083ff20bbfe2ea7 measures 37/37 screens but 3094/3095 RNG calls; first C-only draw at segment 0 step 36 is rn2(100)=39 from obj_resists(zap.c:1469).

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/read.c lines 1294-1396 and do_wear.c lines 3190-3300 define the return-valued disintegration chain; js/read.js seffect_destroy_armor comment explicitly limits it to the uncursed fallback.
The case must remain in the unresolved queue despite 37/37 matching screens because the C RNG trace differs.
